title: Quarterly Orbit Bridge: hosted inference & model garden synchronization
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Goal: Create a compact, executable quarterly plan that aligns the Hosted API roadmap and the Model Garden (model catalog + eval/health signals). This ticket runs an alignment lab across PM/Eng/Design to: 1) define the release lanes and canary flight windows for new model introductions, 2) allocate capacity hedges and cost thresholds for each lane, 3) map OKRs and initiative owners to deliverables, and 4) publish concrete gating criteria (eval pass rates, latency regressions, infra readiness) for Q2 execution.

Scope: Focus on Hosted inference endpoints and the curated Model Garden used by Hosted and Dedicated customers. Excludes private on-prem rollout specifics (separate playbook). Deliverables: 1-page executive decision memo, a cadence schedule for canaries and rotations, labeled rollout lanes in the Console, and a prioritized backlog of model onboarding work tied to OKRs.
updates: 2026-02-15: Kickoff lab with Eng, Design, and Reliability. Collected initial capacity forecasts and three risk scenarios (low/medium/high demand).
2026-02-20: Agreed on 'flight lanes' naming convention (green/gold/red) and preliminary SLA targets per lane. Draft PRD uploaded to Drive (link below).
2026-02-28: Engineering provided kernel/resource constraints for long-context models; trade-off call scheduled to choose between aggressive batching vs. conservative latency targets.
2026-03-04: Design handed over canary UX flows for Console (canary start/rollback/metrics). Requested tighter error surface for partial degradations.
2026-03-08: Decided to require canary eval pass rate >= 98% on critical prompt set + latency P95 delta < 15% for green lane. Documented in gating criteria.
2026-03-10: Draft exec memo circulated for stakeholder review (Growth, CS, Platform). Feedback requested by 2026-03-14.
acceptance_criteria: Exec memo approved by PM and Eng managers
Canary schedule populated into the release calendar for Q2 with owners assigned
Gating criteria published in Confluence and linked from Console rollout UI
Capacity hedge sizes defined and cost budget impact estimated
Backlog of model onboarding tasks prioritized and scoped with estimates
risks: Model diversity vs. latency economics: adding many model variants increases maintenance and cost; we must limit early canaries to high-confidence candidates.
Capacity forecasting uncertainty for seasonal spikes could cause missed SLOs if hedges are undersized.
Eval coverage gaps: current prompt sets may not represent enterprise edge-cases leading to missed regressions.
Cross-team dependency on Dedicated infra changes (ENG-1842) could block rollout windows.
next_steps: Collect stakeholder feedback on exec memo by 2026-03-14 and finalize approvals
Lock canary calendar and communicate to SRE/Dedicated ops teams
Create labeled rollout lanes in Console and wire metric links to per-route dashboards
Run a dry-run canary with low-traffic model in week of 2026-03-22 to validate rollback flows
